meta.title: HavenSpace — personal AI assistant for therapists and psychologists
meta.description: Drafts your session notes and offers gentle, supervisor-style reflection on your own practice. Built in Ireland. Audio deleted after transcription.

landing.heroTitle: Be with your client. We'll take care of the rest.
landing.heroBody: HavenSpace drafts your session notes and gives you gentle, supervisor-style reflection on your own practice. You stay present; the paperwork gets lighter.
landing.howIntro: After the session, not during it. Nothing interrupts the work you do with your client.
landing.step1Body: Record an online call in your browser, a session in the room, upload audio — or simply type or dictate a short recap. Consent is recorded first, always.
landing.step2Body: A draft note in your format — SOAP, DAP, BIRP or free text — ready in a few minutes. Edit anything. Nothing is final until you approve it.
landing.step3Body: Three things you did well, two openings you might revisit, one idea to try next time — each linked to the exact moment in the session.
landing.reflectTitle: Feedback like a good supervisor would give
landing.reflectBody: Warm, specific and respectful. Grounded in the modality you practise — CBT, motivational interviewing, person-centred, solution-focused, DBT — and always pointing to what was actually said.
landing.sampleStrength: You reflected the client's ambivalence back without taking a side, which seemed to give them room to keep exploring.
landing.sampleOpening: When the client mentioned their sister, there may have been an opening to ask what that relationship means to them now.
landing.sampleTry: Next time, you might try a short summary before moving to homework, to check you've understood what matters most.
landing.supervisionBody: Each month, gather a summary of your client work, the moments you want to discuss, your own growth themes and an hours log in a format your supervisor will recognise. Bring it as a PDF.
landing.privacyIntro: Session content is some of the most sensitive information there is. Here's what we do with it, in plain words.
landing.promise1Body: By default, recordings are permanently deleted as soon as the transcript is ready. You can choose to keep them for 7 days instead.
landing.promise2Body: Our database, file storage, speech-to-text and AI processing all run in European data centres.
landing.promise3Body: Your sessions are never used to train our models or anyone else's.
landing.promise4Body: Clients are added by a code or initials. We don't ask for names, addresses or dates of birth.
landing.promise5Body: Recording can't start for a client until their consent is recorded — and withdrawing it stops recording straight away.
landing.promise6Body: Download everything, or delete a client or your whole account, at any time.
landing.not1: It doesn't advise you during a session.
landing.not3: It doesn't score or flag risk. Your notes record what was said, faithfully — the clinical judgement stays with you.
landing.pricingIntro: Free during the pilot. These are our planned prices after it.
landing.planCollegeBody: About €15 per student per month, for training courses.
landing.consentTemplateBody: A plain-language consent form for using a note-taking assistant in your practice. Use it with or without HavenSpace.
landing.footerDisclaimer: HavenSpace is a documentation and reflective-practice tool. It is not a medical device and does not give clinical advice.
landing.joinBody: Book a 20-minute demo with our team, or join the waiting list and we'll let you know when places open.
landing.joinPoint2: Built with a practising psychologist in Ireland
landing.joinPoint3: Role-play sessions first — real client sessions only after an independent privacy review
landing.perkSolo2: Notes in your format, reflection on your technique
landing.perkSolo4: Client app: homework and mood diary
landing.referBody: when they subscribe, you both get a month free.
landing.privacyAlso: Also: clients are added by a code, never a name; recording can't start without consent; and you can export or delete everything at any time.
landing.announce: Pilot places open for counsellors, psychotherapists and psychologists.
landing.videoBody: secure video sessions with your clients and online booking, right inside HavenSpace.
landing.v_step1Body: Video in HavenSpace, Zoom or in the room.
landing.v_step2Body: A draft note in minutes. You edit and approve.
landing.v_step3Body: Gentle feedback, linked to the exact moment.
landing.agentBody: Ask anything about your practice. Arch finds it, links the moment, and does the admin. You approve.
landing.reflectShort: Three things you did well, two openings, one idea to try. Each linked to the moment.
landing.privacyLine: No advice during sessions · no diagnoses · no risk scores · you decide.

consent.textHeading: Using a note-taking assistant in our sessions
consent.textP1: I use a secure assistant called HavenSpace to help me write my session notes and reflect on my own practice as a therapist.
consent.textP2: With your permission, our session is recorded. The recording is turned into a written transcript and then permanently deleted, usually within minutes.
consent.textP3: The transcript is used to draft my notes and to give me feedback on my own work. It is not used to diagnose you or to make decisions about you; I remain responsible for your care and for everything in my notes.
consent.textP4: Everything is stored securely in the European Union. You are identified only by a code, never by your name. Your information is never used to train AI systems.
consent.textP5: Saying no is completely fine and won't affect your therapy in any way. You can change your mind at any time, including during a session; I'll stop recording, and you can ask me to delete what has been recorded.
consent.textP6: You have the right to see the information I hold about you and to ask for it to be corrected or deleted.

privacyPage.title: Privacy, in plain words
privacyPage.intro: HavenSpace handles some of the most sensitive information there is. This page explains exactly what happens to it.
privacyPage.flow1: You record (or upload, or type a recap). Audio is uploaded in small pieces to storage in the EU.
privacyPage.flow2: Our speech-to-text runs on our own servers in the EU. The audio is then permanently deleted.
privacyPage.flow3: The transcript (text only, with a pseudonym, never a name) is sent to an AI model hosted in the EU to draft your note and reflection.
privacyPage.flow4: You review, edit and approve. You can export or delete everything at any time.
privacyPage.whoBody: Every company that touches your data is listed on our sub-processor page, with what they do and where.
privacyPage.rightsTitle: Your rights and your clients' rights
privacyPage.rightsBody: You can export or delete a client's data, or your whole account, from Settings. If a client asks you for their data, you can export it for them.
privacyPage.never1: We never use session content to train AI.
privacyPage.never2: We never sell or share data for advertising.
privacyPage.never3: We never put session content in logs, analytics or error reports.
privacyPage.never4: We never score risk, suggest diagnoses or advise you during a session.
privacyPage.status: Honest status: we're in a pilot. Before real client sessions are allowed, an independent Data Protection Impact Assessment will be completed.
privacyPage.contact: Questions about privacy? Write to us — a contact address will be published before launch.

dpa.title: Data Processing Agreement
dpa.draft: Draft — this summary will be replaced by a full agreement reviewed by legal counsel before real client data is allowed.
dpa.intro: When you use HavenSpace for your practice, you are the data controller for your clients' information and we act as your data processor. In summary, we commit to:
dpa.p1: Process session data only on your instructions, to provide the service you use.
dpa.p2: Keep all session data in the European Union.
dpa.p3: Delete audio after transcription by default, and delete everything else when you ask or close your account.
dpa.p4: Never use session data to train AI models, and never sell or share it for advertising.
dpa.p5: Use only the sub-processors we list, and tell you before we add a new one.
dpa.p6: Protect data with encryption in transit and at rest, access controls and an audit log.
dpa.p7: Help you respond to your clients' data protection requests (access, correction, deletion).
dpa.p8: Tell you without undue delay if we become aware of a personal data breach.

heroDemo.label: Example: a role-play session becomes a draft note and a reflection.
heroDemo.line1: What's been on your mind since we last met?
heroDemo.line2: Work, mostly. I keep replaying meetings when I'm trying to sleep.
heroDemo.line3: So the day follows you to bed.
heroDemo.line4: Exactly. And by Wednesday I'm exhausted.
heroDemo.noteData: Client described ongoing work stress and replaying meetings at night when trying to sleep.
heroDemo.noteAssess: Client linked midweek tiredness to evening rumination. Engaged and reflective throughout.
heroDemo.notePlan: Explore a wind-down routine together. Review a short sleep diary next session.
heroDemo.well: Your reflection “the day follows you to bed” helped the client name the pattern themselves.
heroDemo.try: A brief summary before agreeing homework, to check what matters most to them.
heroDemo.arch_listening: I'm listening. Stay with your client.
heroDemo.arch_writing: Session ended. Audio deleted. Writing your note…
heroDemo.arch_done: Your note is ready. You decide.

devices.title: HavenSpace on all your devices
devices.body: Install it like an app on your computer and phone. It opens in its own window.
devices.macLine: Install from Chrome or Edge. It sits in your Dock.
devices.windowsLine: Install from Chrome or Edge. It sits in your Start menu.
devices.iphoneLine: Add it to your Home Screen from Safari.
devices.androidLine: Install from Chrome. It sits on your home screen.
devices.macStep1: Open havenspace in Chrome or Edge.
devices.macStep2: Click the install icon at the right of the address bar (a screen with an arrow).
devices.macStep3: Click Install. HavenSpace opens in its own window and appears in your Dock.
devices.windowsStep1: Open havenspace in Chrome or Edge.
devices.windowsStep2: Click the install icon at the right of the address bar.
devices.windowsStep3: Click Install. HavenSpace appears in your Start menu.
devices.iphoneStep2: Tap Share (the square with an arrow).
devices.iphoneStep3: Tap Add to Home Screen, then Add.
devices.androidStep2: Tap the menu (three dots), then Install app.
devices.androidStep3: HavenSpace appears on your home screen.
devices.bodyDownloads: Download the app for your Mac, Windows computer or Android phone. On iPhone, add it to your Home Screen.
devices.testBuild: This is a test version, so your device asks once before opening it.
devices.macDownloadLine: For macOS 12 or later, on Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
devices.macOpen1: Open HavenSpace-Mac.dmg and drag HavenSpace into Applications.
devices.macOpen2: Open HavenSpace. If macOS says it can't check the app, click Done.
devices.macOpen3: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll down and click Open Anyway. You only do this once.
devices.windowsOpen2: If “Windows protected your PC” appears, click More info, then Run anyway.
devices.windowsOpen3: HavenSpace opens and appears in your Start menu.
devices.androidOpen1: Tap Download. If Chrome asks, tap Download anyway.
devices.androidOpen2: Open the file. If asked, allow Chrome to install apps.
devices.androidOpen3: If Play Protect warns you, tap More details, then Install anyway.

decks.title: Card decks
decks.oursBody: Ready to use in any video session (Tools → Associative cards). Every deck here is free for you to use: made by us, or in the public domain.
decks.about_pathways: Gentle illustrations of paths, doors, homes and weather, each with a question to open the conversation.
decks.about_art: Paintings with windows, roads, rooms, the sea, and people alone and together.
decks.about_faces: Portraits of people of different ages and backgrounds: for feelings, roles, relationships and inner parts.
decks.about_abstract: Soft colours and shapes with no fixed meaning: for states, moods and what's hard to put into words.
decks.about_words: Single words to use alone or with a picture card: home, fear, boundary, hope…
decks.about_resources: Strengths and sources of support, each with a question about where it shows up in the client's life.
decks.credit_pathways: Created for HavenSpace by our Clinical Lead. Illustrations and questions © HavenSpace.
decks.credit_art: Works in the public domain (CC0), Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access.
decks.credit_faces: Works in the public domain (CC0), Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access.
decks.mineBody: Upload your own cards (up to {cards} per deck). Only you can see your decks; in a session, your client sees just the cards on screen.
